fatal_errors: The proposed severe-plastic-deformation and oxidation treatment does not reconstruct the reported AlCoCrFeNi atmospheric-plasma-sprayed coating and 550 °C annealing intervention.

The cited evidence does not support the central claim that ultrafine grains accelerate chromium transport and thereby improve passivation. E3 and E5 explicitly report that HPT-induced ultrafine grains had little or negligible influence on passive-film protection and corrosion resistance.
No cited finding establishes that a 400 °C oxidation treatment after severe plastic deformation produces the proposed continuous chromium-rich film or improved long-term corrosion resistance.
The experiment lacks an oxidation-only coarse-grained control, so it cannot distinguish a synergistic UFG-plus-oxidation mechanism from an effect caused by oxidation alone.
explanation: The hypothesis addresses corrosion-resistant steels and proposes measurable mediators and outcomes, so it is aligned with the broad problem and is independently testable. However, it is not a reconstruction of the target study: it substitutes bulk grain refinement by high-pressure torsion and controlled oxidation for an approximately 150 µm AlCoCrFeNi HEA coating deposited by atmospheric plasma spraying and annealed at 550 °C. The target mechanism centers on coating microstructure, Al/Cr-rich oxides, sluggish diffusion, and resistance to acid and molten-salt penetration; only the generic role of chromium-rich passivation overlaps. Conditions are also underspecified and do not reproduce 3.5 wt% H2SO4 or 900 °C cyclic Na2SO4/NaCl/V2O5 exposure. The proposed controls and XPS, SKP, EBSD, and polarization measurements are useful, but a full factorial design including coarse-grained plus oxidation is required to establish the governing cause. Evidence discipline is poor: E1 concerns HEA tribology, E2 reports a damaged non-passive Al-HEA oxide, E4 concerns sluggish diffusion in an HEA, and E3/E5 directly weaken the asserted UFG contribution. Thus, the proposal is novel and scientifically conceivable but unsupported by the supplied evidence and insufficiently controlled to establish its claimed dual-step mechanism.
